source.citation: Williams, Fremstad, Burkhardt, and Lou (2026 draft), Valuing global wildfire smoke mortality caused by climate change

method_facts.concentration_response: linearized all-source long-term PM2.5 hazard ratio from Pope et al. (2020)
method_facts.climate_smoke_response: country-specific change in wildfire PM2.5 exposure per degree of global mean warming from a 43-simulation literature ensemble

known_source_ambiguities: The text describes 2025 through 2300 as 275 years, while the inclusive calendar-year count is 276.
The numerical CO2 pulse magnitude and gas mass convention are not stated in the draft.
The source says 2% discounting but the exact source code and parameter realization are unavailable locally.
permitted_use: source-pinned external scalar benchmark and target for reproduction; not by itself authorization to add to baseline GIVE
prohibited_use: redistribution of the draft or representation of the scalar as a locally reproduced additive SCC component
